name: David Buckley
sources: Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (Township 9, Placer County, California; post office Secret Ravine)
notes: Born about 1825 in Ireland. In 1860 a miner in Township 9, Placer County, California (post office Secret Ravine), aged 35, with his wife Margaret and daughters Mary A. (8), Julia C. (5) and Hannah (3), all born in Louisiana. Margaret was a widow by 1870, so he died between 1860 and 1870.
Inferred: the father of Hannah Louise Buckley (Trumbo), from the 1860 household and her mother's and sister's later households in Idaho.
Lead: next door to him in 1860 lived Michael Buckley, 45, a miner born in Ireland, perhaps a relative.
